limits: Actual shared global FLS index observed onX86/X64 currentWindows. Two live worker threads store isolated values; natural worker exit invokes each callback on its owner thread. FlsFree with workers still alive invokes both callbacks synchronously on freeing caller; later worker exit does not duplicate callbacks.
Callback only records opaque data/thread identity. Core destructor, global native CRT bootstrap, shared provider/error handling/concurrency and normal game worker integration remain to qualify.
